decisions.reason: Building on the established offer, its uncertainty is not yet resolved and keeping costs are low, so the option remains worth more than its carrying cost.
Close to the core product range and with no sign that its value is unlikely, the option is retained.
Although distant from the established offer and potentially costlier to support, its prospects remain uncertain and the firm holds few other options, so it is kept while uncertainty lasts.
A product line close to the established offer with several models indicates a valuable option and a low drop risk.
